steps.say: An adaptation is a feature that helps a living thing survive in its habitat.
A camel has wide feet for sand and can go a long time without water. A cactus stores water in its thick stem.
Polar bears have thick fur and a layer of fat to keep warm in the cold. Rainforest plants have leaves with pointed tips to let rain drip off.
Flowers have bright petals and sweet nectar to attract insects. Light seeds, hooks and fruits help seeds travel to new places.
Predators have sharp teeth or claws and eyes at the front to hunt. Prey animals often have eyes on the sides to spot danger, or fast legs and camouflage.
